(sqrt(1-y^2)/p) * x/sqrt(1-x^2) + (1/x) * (x^2y^2-1)/(sqrt((1-y^2)(1-x^2)) p) = -sqrt(1-x^2)/(x p sqrt(1-y^2)).

This is exactly Riemann's line 3, with the stray 'lambda' being a cancelled '1-1'.
